title: Schedule A to the Wayfare Driver Agreements: Entry Gates and Vehicle Limits by Service Level
content:
Under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product, every Wayfare driver agreement is signed for one service level, and each level sets an entry gate for the driver and limits for the registered vehicle. This schedule gives those figures for all six levels.

## Entry gate for the driver

| | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Minimum driver age (years) | 21 | 21 | 21 | 21 | 21 | 21 |
| Minimum years licensed | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 3 | 3 |
| Minimum rating to join | 0.00 | 0.00 | 4.85 | 4.70 | 4.85 | 4.85 |
| Minimum lifetime trips to join | 0 | 0 | 100 | 0 | 500 | 500 |

## Vehicle limits

| | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Oldest vehicle accepted (years) | 15 | 10 | 6 | 10 | 6 | 6 |
| Fewest passenger seats | 4 | 4 | 4 | 6 | 4 | 6 |
| Powertrains accepted | gasoline, hybrid, plug-in hybrid, battery electric | hybrid, plug-in hybrid, battery electric | gasoline, hybrid, plug-in hybrid, battery electric | gasoline, hybrid, plug-in hybrid, battery electric | gasoline, hybrid, plug-in hybrid, battery electric | gasoline, hybrid, plug-in hybrid, battery electric |
| Date vehicle age steps up | January 1 | January 1 | January 1 | January 1 | January 1 | January 1 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Oldest vehicle accepted.** Vehicle age is counted as the current calendar year less the vehicle's model year, in years; the figure in the table is the oldest age the level accepts.
2. **Age step-up.** Vehicle age steps up on January 1 each year on every level; a vehicle that ages out of a level leaves the level that day.
3. **Seats.** The figure is the fewest passenger seats the registered vehicle must have.
4. **Powertrains.** Only the powertrains listed for a level are accepted for it. The Wayfare Green level is the only level that does not accept a gasoline powertrain.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical vehicles)

- A hypothetical vehicle of model year 2016 is 10 years old in calendar year 2026: within the 15-year limit of Wayfare Standard and at the 10-year limit of Wayfare Green and Wayfare XL, but above the 6-year limit of Wayfare Comfort, Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV. On January 1, 2027 it becomes 11 years old and leaves the Green and XL limits that day.
- A hypothetical 5-seat hybrid meets the 4-seat minimum of Standard, Green, Comfort and Black, but not the 6-seat minimum of Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV.
